description.narrative: Philippines - Community Development Grants Project - Project Administration Costs activity: MCC Funding will be granted to DSWD to provide salaries and training for Department of Social Welfare and Development ("DSWD") project management staff at the regional and national level. These funds will also be used for the office space, conferences, capacity building and project monitoring associated with the project management activity.
